name: Mimasaka Shinji
source:
Leader of the archery club and an honor student who always takes the top place at his prestigious school. Shinji has an unapproachable atmosphere, he is very serious and straight-laced, many girls love him because of his demeanor and handsome appearance. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050407195831/http://zui.co.jp/products/kashoku/kashoku.html]official website[/url].]
